qualification: local A05.3 rejected narrow mixed-compiler edge experiment; not A05.3 closure, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

candidate.scope: Admit only legacy-memory to tier-one targets because the existing legacy memory chain epilogue restores the canonical x0-x5 generated-function entry tuple. Callback-free legacy sources and every tier-one-to-legacy edge remained separated.
candidate.behavioralIntent: Reuse the already-generated callback-preserving epilogue without adding host pointers to guest context or changing emitted machine code.
candidate.productionFinding: The guest corrupted kernel console strings before userspace, then busybox faulted during exec and the kernel repeatedly reported scheduling-while-atomic failures. Execution remained live in page-table and scheduler code until the full instruction budget expired without an authenticated guest receipt.

verification.deterministicAggregate: 1,557 tests in 179 suites passed with test parallelism disabled; the environment-driven pinned boot test skipped because its variables were absent, then the frozen fixture was executed explicitly.
verification.reasonSecondAttemptSkipped: The complete failure receipt reproduces the same pre-userspace string corruption and scheduler/page-table loop as the earlier broad legacy-to-tier-one admission. A second one-billion-instruction run cannot establish acceptance and was not used to manufacture additional evidence.

corruptionMarkers: NUL bytes inside the RCU trampoline line
NUL bytes inside the PCI ECAM/domain line
NUL bytes inside the refined TSC max-cycles line

retainedBaseline.reason: It remains the last behavior-neutral mixed-compiler-separated production measurement.

disposition.reason: Even a legacy memory source that restores x0-x5 is not sufficient to make the compiler boundary safe. The failure-run 65.01 percent avoidance is invalid for performance acceptance because guest correctness failed. The admission is fully reverted.

limitations: The failure receipt identifies the corrupted workload phase and terminal loop but not the exact mixed-compiler edge that first corrupts architectural state.
Because correctness failed, none of the candidate's performance counters are accepted as progress toward the dispatcher gate.
The directed two-block regression does not cover live flag descriptors, block-local checkpoint metadata, or every memory instruction family at a mixed compiler boundary.
